scale: 120000 SCR (12 x the SR10 000 monthly threshold of the 20 % band (citizens))
registry_correction: SC: Income and Non-Monetary Benefits Tax Act 2010 (Cap 273): monthly per-source emoluments tax, citizens nil to SR8 555.50, 15 % to SR10 000, 20 % to SR83 333, 30 % above; non-citizens 15 % from the first rupee.
headline: Seychelles built from the emoluments tax schedule (Act 27 of 2017): monthly and per source of employment, so two employers each give a nil band; a non-citizen on SR20 000 a month pays SR15 400 a year more than a citizen.
